claims.value: New operator constraint: the next experiment is exactly one 30-minute dev-only alpha soak, with no production changes and no durable controller persistence. Acceptance requires at least 900 PGCR/sec steady throughput during the final 10 minutes, zero integrity or recovery violations, no DB connection failure storm, and a successful controlled-stop restart from DB truth.

answer.answer: Revised child checkpoint: the three heavy machines require three separate level-0 Base Core sites. Their machine-only heat loads are 500, 650, and 650; no two may share a core because every pairing exceeds the 1,000 capacity.

claims.value: The parent architecture was an Update 1-only distributed backbone-and-spurs network with a protected core hub, modular processing cells, mining outposts, conservative heat margin, and unlock-gated logistics.

The new requirement is one Constructorizer plus two Facturers while all Base Cores remain level 0. Machine heat is 500 + 650 + 650 = 1,800 total. A level-0 core has 1,000 capacity, and exceeding it disables Fire Wave protection.

Use at least three occupied level-0 core sites: one Constructorizer site at 500 machine heat with 500 headroom, and two Facturer sites at 650 machine heat with 350 headroom each. Reject Constructorizer-plus-Facturer co-location at 1,150 and two-Facturer co-location at 1,300; all supporting powered buildings must fit within each site's remaining headroom.

Before construction, verify that the Constructorizer, Facturer, recipes, power sources, and logistics components are actually unlocked in the Update 1 save, then draft and validate each site's complete heat ledger against its core panel. Use only confirmed Update 1 equipment and begin construction only when every site remains at or below 1,000 heat with deliberate operating margin.

checkpoint.objective: Build an Update 1-only distributed factory operating one Constructorizer and two Facturers while every Base Core remains level 0 and every occupied core retains Fire Wave protection.
current_state: The prior distributed backbone-and-spurs architecture remains the foundation; the former plan to postpone heavy machines is superseded by the explicit requirement to operate one Constructorizer and two Facturers.
Required machine-only heat is 1,800: Constructorizer 500 plus two Facturers at 650 each.
A level-0 Base Core provides 1,000 capacity; exceeding capacity disables that core's Fire Wave protection.
No two required heavy machines can safely share a level-0 core: Constructorizer plus Facturer is 1,150, and two Facturers are 1,300.
The build therefore requires at least three occupied level-0 Base Core sites before accounting for supporting buildings.
decisions: Assign the Constructorizer to a dedicated level-0 core site: 500 machine heat and at most 500 remaining heat for all local support.
Assign each Facturer to its own dedicated level-0 core site: 650 machine heat and at most 350 remaining heat per site for all local support.
Reject every layout that co-locates any pair of the three required heavy machines under one level-0 core.

Retain distributed, single-item rail feeds and buffers where actually unlocked; use Rail v.1-v.3 only as measured throughput requires, and exclude future Rail v.4/v.5, hidden equipment, and unverified unlocks.

Treat the stated headroom as a hard upper bound, not a support allowance to consume automatically; include generation, extraction, processing, storage, and every other powered building in the responsible core's pre-build heat ledger.
Do not rely on Base Core Amplifiers to make the plan safe because their documented capacity values conflict; any later use requires in-game verification and a revised ledger.

What complete supporting production and logistics chain is required by each selected recipe, and under which core will each supporting building's heat be counted?
next_actions: Inspect the live Update 1 build and recipe menus and record the unlocked Constructorizer, Facturer, recipes, power sources, rails, and buffers; exclude hidden, future, pre-Update-1, and merely database-listed content.
Select three distinct level-0 Base Core sites and record each core panel's current load before placing anything.

Prepare three complete site ledgers: existing load plus heavy-machine heat plus all local generation, logistics, processing, storage, and defense heat. Require each total to remain at or below 1,000 with deliberate margin.
Reject or redesign any ledger above its core limit; do not compensate by co-locating required heavy machines or assuming disputed Amplifier capacity.
